messages:
Maria: Heads-up — Acme (acct 84012) can't reconcile invoice 2024-AC-9876 because the PO# is missing on the PDF they downloaded. They need a reissued invoice with the PO and VAT breakdown; payments team is refusing to accept without PO. @billing-team please advise.

AJ: Can you paste the invoice id + the PO they provided (if any)?

Maria: Invoice details below:
```
invoice_id: 2024-AC-9876
amount: $12,450.00
customer_po: (not on invoice)
customer_account: Acme Corp (84012)
```
Customer says PO is "PO-AC-3344" — they added it to the portal after payment. Screenshot: https://uploads.company/acme/po-snap.png

BillingBot: Automated note: Invoice 2024-AC-9876 paid on 2024-04-21 14:12 UTC. Payment method: Amex ****1234. Status: Paid. For reissue, recommended flow: credit memo -> refund or apply credit -> reissue invoice.

Priya: Since it's already paid we'll need credit + rebill. Two quick questions: 1) Do they need VAT split per EU country? 2) Is the billed legal entity different from the PO entity?

Kevin: From finance — required steps (high level):
1) Confirm legal entity for Acme (billing ledger).
2) Create credit memo for full amount against 2024-AC-9876.
3) Refund or settle payment (refund to card) OR create internal credit and apply to new invoice (customer preference dependent).
4) Create new invoice (eg. 2024-AC-9876-R) with PO field populated with "PO-AC-3344" and correct VAT lines.
5) Update GL/ledger and attach credit memo + proof of change.
Timeline: ~2 business days to issue credit (depends on gateway), +1 day to reissue once credit is applied. Taxes validation may add a day.

Sophie: Credit is > $10k so Legal sign-off needed. @Legal can you review and approve netting vs refund? I'll loop the AM.

Maria: Customer prefers we net the credit to the new invoice instead of refunding the card (they want to avoid card refund/recharge fees). Can finance do apply-credit workflow or do we have to refund first? :pray:

Kevin: We can create a credit memo and apply it to the new invoice in our system, but if the original payment was a card charge we usually need to refund the card in the gateway to keep accounts receivable clean. Option B: we create an internal credit and mark original payment as 'applied' against new invoice (requires ops approval). I'll escalate to payments ops. :thinking_face:

Priya: Adding repro / internal checklist for ticket SUP-4337:
- Confirm payment status via gateway
- Confirm exact PO text and attach screenshot
- Create credit memo (eg CM-2024-AC-009) referencing invoice
- If refund required, submit refund request with gateway (include last4 and txn id)
- Create reissued invoice with PO field populated and updated VAT lines
- Attach credit memo + PO screenshot to new invoice PDF
- Notify customer & cc AM (Sophie).

Maria: Draft customer note:
"Hi Sam — thanks. We've created a credit for your original invoice and will reissue a new invoice that includes PO PO-AC-3344 and the requested VAT breakdown. You can expect the credit to be processed within 2 business days. Please let us know if you'd prefer a refund to the card instead of applying the credit."

AJ: Tagging @ops for priority processing. Please update SUP-4337 when credit memo created. :eyes:

BillingBot: Action required — create credit memo against INV 2024-AC-9876. KB: <https://redwood.internal/kb/billing/reissue-invoice>

Kevin: I'm creating the credit memo now and assigning to Kevin-finops. ETA EOD today for credit memo issuance; refund (if needed) may take additional 24-48 hours depending on gateway.

Sophie: I'll ping Legal and the AM to get sign-off and notify the customer. Will update thread when Legal replies. :thumbsup:
